user.title: HA IPTV
user.description: A new stick shows up by itself under Discovered. Otherwise enter its IP and leave the token empty: you approve on the TV.

data.token: Access token (leave empty to approve on the TV)

launch.title: Name and wake-up (optional)
launch.description: To start the app or wake the TV from HA when it is closed, pick the Android TV (ADB) media player of the stick and the TV.

data.turn_off_tv: Turn off also switches TV off
data.device_name: Name of this TV (shown on your other TVs, e.g. Living room)
data.copy_login: Copy the provider login from the TV already set up (no typing on this TV)

error.cannot_connect: The app did not answer. Open HA IPTV on the stick (TV on) and check IP/port.
error.copy_failed: Could not copy the provider login. Check that the other TV is on, or type it on this TV.

abort.pair_closed: This TV is not accepting new pairings. On the TV open Settings › Pair a new Home Assistant, then try again.
abort.pair_busy: Another pairing request is waiting on that TV. Try again in two minutes.
abort.pair_expired: Nobody approved on the TV in time. Start again.
abort.cannot_connect: The app did not answer. Open HA IPTV on the stick (TV on).

progress.approve:
Press OK on the TV to approve, **only if it shows the code {code}**.

{name} is waiting for your approval.

data.turn_off_tv: Turn off also switches TV off
data.device_name: Name of this TV (shown on your other TVs, e.g. Living room)

play_channel.name: Play channel
play_channel.description: Tune to a channel by id or by name search; optionally prefer a group.

zap.name: Zap
zap.description: Next or previous channel within the current group/favourites.

set_region.name: Set region
set_region.description: Browse to a region (e.g. UK, PL); optionally start its first channel.

set_group.name: Set group
set_group.description: Browse to a group by id or name; optionally start its first channel.

favourite.name: Favourite
favourite.description: Add/remove/toggle a channel in Favourites (default: the playing one).

watch_programme.name: Watch programme
watch_programme.description: When a programme matching the title starts, tune in (or just fire an event).

remove_watch.name: Remove watch
remove_watch.description: Delete a programme watch by id or title.

sleep_timer.name: Sleep timer
sleep_timer.description: Stop playback after N minutes (0 cancels).

survey_group.name: Survey group quality
survey_group.description: Tune every channel in a group briefly to measure its real resolution.

quality_report.name: Quality report
quality_report.description: Claimed vs measured quality for a group's channels.

continue_on.name: Continue on another TV
continue_on.description: Carry on here with what another TV was playing (channel or film/episode, from the same position). The other TV is stopped first because the account allows one stream.

entry_id.name: Target TV
entry_id.description: The TV that should start playing (config entry id). Default: the first one.

source_entry_id.name: Source TV
source_entry_id.description: Take over from this TV (config entry id). Default: whichever played most recently.

stop_source.name: Stop the source
stop_source.description: Stop playback on the source TV.

sync_now.name: Sync now
sync_now.description: Exchange favourites, list order and resume points between all TVs right now.
